m4ri.mapping: output[c][r] = input[r][c]; row words use bit c = 1u64 << c
m4ri.padding: M4RI zeroes unused tail bits in partial words
m4ri.aliasing: distinct input/output; fixed output allocation is reused during kernel timing

bitshuffle.unavailable_reason: element count is not a multiple of 8; no padding substitution is timed
bitshuffle.aliasing: distinct input/output as required by the Bitshuffle interface

logical_xor.arrangement_cost: the three-pointer array is formed inside every timed call
logical_xor.aliasing: unavailable: ISA-L does not contractually permit destination/source aliasing

bch_genmatrix.equivalence: full-rank row-space equality after both documented layouts are reindexed to internal polynomial-degree order
bch_genmatrix.raw_dump_identity: falsified; bases and systematic column layouts differ
